parameter_provenance: All settings below belong exclusively to this software benchmark. Temperature, pressure, feed and directed rate parameters are the researcher's B.2.3.2.4 proposals, accepted here only as dimensioned software controls. No measured oxide parameters.

gas.mass_source: Zacros 4.0 distributed example 100, simulation_input.dat, CO2 column. Used as an unlabeled software control.

energetics.reference: Empty lattice and gas CO2 have zero energy. Sites are inequivalent, bridge legs ordered.
energetics.selection: Benchmark choices. The bound-state energy equals Ea_ads minus Ea_des. A bridge is one molecular cluster with two sites. All multi-entity interaction terms are zero and omitted. A symmetric proximity factor has no barrier shift for this additive expansion.
